correctness.rationale: For generic marked endpoints each nonempty interval-query trace is recoverable from its minimum included right endpoint and maximum included left endpoint. There are at most B=1+binom(m+1,2) query traces, minus one per strict containment pair. A probe just past the earliest right endpoint or just before the latest left endpoint reproduces that mark's open trace; if these marks coincide, their m−1 containments more than compensate for the missing second probe. Thus equality for m≥3 excludes containment, requires all B contiguous blocks, and makes every interior marked trace noncontiguous. Each interior singleton block forces its two neighbors to be disjoint; a noncontiguous marked trace then requires both consecutive overlaps. Conversely a proper ordered path representation has a private segment in each marked interval, so probes give all contiguous blocks and the interior marks give every extra pattern. Thus every ordered path as an ordered graph extends, with an appropriate representation. The statement does not guarantee extension of arbitrary fixed coordinates: an ordered path may be represented with containment. The endpoint marks both give the middle singleton at m=3, so realizing eight traces requires nine vertices; their singleton traces differ for m≥4, and omitting the already realized block probes attains the one-vertex-per-trace lower bound. The m=1,2 witnesses and the 8-to-13 shattering boundary check directly.
residual_risks: The converse is about extension of the ordered graph (or a proper ordered path representation), not every fixed realization of it. Finite checks are corroboration; the endpoint argument gives the all-size result. Uploaded executable evidence was inspected, not executed.
